product.name: STARKVIND table with air purifier
product.introText: STARKVIND table with air purifier, 54 cm, oak veneer. Assembly AA-2286111, use AA-2284600 (knob: press = Auto / Off, turn = speed 1-5, hold = lock). When assembled, press "Use it" to switch the purifier on. Room air runs at 30x speed.
product.partsSummary: 1x Body,  1x Filter,  4x Leg,  8x Lscrew,  1x Plug,  1x Power cable,  1x Power strip,  1x Pre filter,  1x Top

steps.title: Legs
steps.text: Put the purifier body upside down on a soft surface. Push the 4 legs into the sockets - the leg with the cable groove goes at the back.

steps.title: Fix the legs
steps.text: Fix each leg with 2 screws using the Allen key (8 screws).

steps.title: Power cable
steps.text: Turn the table over and stand it on its legs. Connect the power supply cable to the socket under the body and lead it down the back leg.

steps.title: Power strip
steps.text: Slide a power strip (not included) under the end of the cable, on the floor behind the table.

steps.title: Particle filter
steps.text: Unpack the particle filter (remove the plastic bag) and lay it into the top of the body.

steps.title: Pre-filter
steps.text: Put the pre-filter grid on top and press it down until it clicks (2x2 catches).

steps.title: Table top
steps.text: Lay the table top on and press until the 4 clips click.

steps.title: Plug in
steps.text: Plug the purifier in. The LEDs light up in turn - then it is ready.
